content: Data-driven page architecture separates data from presentation: a schema'd content registry holds per-page data; one page template renders it; a section registry (object mapping section type key to component, no switch statements) drives composition; per-page differences are expressed as config/data, with a component-map override as the deliberate escape hatch. Adding content = adding a registry entry, not new components. Build-time (prebuild script or import-time registry read) keeps static output fresh.
